title: Sega Saturn
description: A disc's boot sectors (IP.BIN at $06002000) and its first program, one source for the SH-2 (source/sh2_writer), each under its own .org: the header field by field, flow from the four area-code entries, the initial program and the first program's start, the Saturn's and the SH7604's registers by name, work RAM, video and sound memory as var_ equates. The lane runs a disc of its own holding the rebuilt system area and program.
